description: This file defines a PHP class 'Config' within the OrangeHRM project. The class is an entity managed by Doctrine ORM, representing configuration entries in the 'hs_hr_config' database table. It contains properties for 'name' and 'value' with corresponding getter and setter methods.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Entity class representing a configuration setting, mapped to 'hs_hr_config' database table.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the configuration setting.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the configuration setting.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the value of the configuration setting.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value of the configuration setting.
